stem: You rename the parameters of `sendAlert` in an internal `notify-kit` package. You run Grep for `sendAlert`, update every hit, and the tests pass. In production, the on-call paging flow breaks. The package's `index.js` has `export { sendAlert as notify }`, and `helpers/alerts.js` wraps it as `pageOncall`. The paging flow only calls `pageOncall`. What is the root cause of the missed callers?
options: Grep cannot search nested package directories, so those files were skipped
The search used only the original name, missing the alias and wrapper names
Reading the index file alone shows every caller importing through it
Globbing all JavaScript files first would have exposed every remaining usage
explain: The search covered only `sendAlert`, so callers using the alias `notify` or the wrapper `pageOncall` were never found. The fix is to list all exported names first, then Grep for each one. Grep searches nested directories fine, so the second option is wrong. Reading `index.js` alone is wrong because `pageOncall` callers import from `helpers/alerts.js`, not from the index. Globbing finds files by name, not usages, so it would not reveal them without reading everything up front.
concept: Trace wrapper and aliased usages by searching every exported name
